command:
set -euo pipefail
echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(id -un)
echo VOICE_SERVICE
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
echo CLIENT_SERVICE
systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
echo FRANK_REPOS
for d in /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo REPO=$d HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD); git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1; fi; done
echo OMEGA_BIN
command -v omega || true
if command -v omega >/dev/null 2>&1; then omega status || true; omega selftest || true; fi
